items.brief_en: braindecode merged three substantial PRs today: a new NeuroRVQ foundation model, BrainOmni as a downstream classifier for BrainTokenizer, and electrode geometry now supplied by the caller in from_pretrained. New baselines are usable the same day, while the pretrained-weight loading change is breaking for existing reproduction scripts.

同日 PR #1232 修改 from_pretrained：输入电极几何改由调用方传入，不再从 Hub 配置读取，会影响预训练权重的加载方式。
该库是 EEG/ECG/MEG 深度学习的常用开源基线（约 1.3k stars），也是 EEG 基础模型复现与对比的主要载体。

PR #1232 changes from_pretrained so input electrode geometry comes from the caller instead of the Hub config, affecting how pretrained weights load.
The library is a standard open-source baseline for deep learning on EEG, ECG and MEG (about 1.3k stars) and the main venue for reproducing EEG foundation models.

items.brief_en: MNE-ICALabel v0.10.0 ships a Torch fix under float64 defaults and moves packaging to a src layout with uv dependency groups, plus it stops warning when average referencing is used as a projection - relevant for automated artifact rejection in EEG pipelines.
items.title_zh: MNE-ICALabel 发布 v0.10.0：修复 Torch float64 精度并现代化打包
items.title_en: MNE-ICALabel v0.10.0: Torch float64 Fix and Modernized Packaging
bullets_zh: ICA 成分自动标注库 MNE-ICALabel 发布 v0.10.0，修复 PyTorch 后端在 float64 默认精度下的失败（PR #325）。
打包改为 src layout、setuptools_scm、依赖分组与 uv（PR #332），安装与二次开发方式随之调整。
当平均参考以投影方式使用时不再误报缺少 CAR 的告警（PR #316）。
bullets_en: MNE-ICALabel, the automatic ICA component labeling library, released v0.10.0 including a fix for Torch ICLabel under a float64 default dtype (PR #325).
Packaging moved to a src layout with setuptools_scm, dependency groups and uv (PR #332), changing install and development workflows.
It no longer warns about a missing average reference when average referencing is used as a projection (PR #316).
items.brief: 用于 ICA 成分自动标注（自动识别眼电、肌电等伪迹成分）的 MNE-ICALabel 发布 v0.10.0。两处对使用者有实际影响：PyTorch 后端在 float64 默认精度下的报错被修复，打包切换到 src layout 与 uv 依赖组后安装和二次开发方式变化；同时消除了使用平均参考时的伪告警。适合嵌入 EEG 预处理流水线做自动去伪迹。

items.brief_en: squiggly, an open-source browser-based EEG viewer, added divergence-style topomaps, a QC rejection timeline and noise-correction overlays within 24 hours, and moved mains-hum notching before the artifact pipeline - useful for teaching and remote review without installing anything.

bullets_zh: 浏览器端 EEG 可视化与分析工具 squiggly 新增分歧风格脑地形图、伪迹剔除时间线，以及噪声校正叠加显示。
默认低通滤波改为 45 Hz，并在去噪模式中标出所用频带；工频干扰改到伪迹流水线之前去除，同时修正奈奎斯特频率附近的陷波带宽。
bullets_en: The browser-based EEG viewer squiggly added divergence-style topomaps, an artifact-rejection timeline and a noise-correction overlay.
The default low-pass moved to 45 Hz with the processed band shown in noise-correction mode; mains hum is now removed before the artifact pipeline, with notch bandwidth fixed near Nyquist.
items.brief: 基于 Web 的开源 EEG 查看与分析器 squiggly 在 24 小时内连续更新：加入 divergence 风格脑地形图、质控剔除时间轴与噪声校正叠加，并把工频陷波移到伪迹流水线之前、修正奈奎斯特附近的陷波带宽。对教学演示、远程读图和质控复核很实用：无需安装即可在浏览器中查看原始波形与处理过程，也便于把质控决策可视化给协作者。

items.brief_en: A complete non-invasive BCI teaching project created today: SSVEP stimuli, Bluetooth EEG capture and FBCCA classification mapped to robot-arm actions, with YOLOv8 for target detection. The README documents the frequency-intent-action mapping and module split, though the repo has no history or licence yet.
items.title_zh: SSVEP 脑控机械臂端到端实现（FBCCA + YOLOv8，今日新建仓库）
items.title_en: End-to-End SSVEP Brain-Controlled Robot Arm (FBCCA + YOLOv8, Created Today)
bullets_zh: 今日新建的中文仓库：以稳态视觉诱发电位（SSVEP）识别意图，控制机械臂完成杯子定位、抓取与搬运。
链路为 PyQt5 呈现 10-15 Hz 视觉刺激、蓝牙 BLE 采集脑电、FBCCA 频率识别后写入 eeg_trigger.json，再由控制脚本读取指令。
目标检测由 YOLOv8 完成并配合卡尔曼滤波与椭圆拟合标定，仓库含三个模块脚本、requirements.txt 与 yolov8s.pt 权重。
bullets_en: A Chinese repository created today: SSVEP-based intent recognition drives a robot arm through cup detection, grasping and transport.
The pipeline shows 10-15 Hz stimuli in PyQt5, records EEG over Bluetooth BLE, classifies with FBCCA into eeg_trigger.json and hands commands to the control script.
Target detection uses YOLOv8 with Kalman filtering and ellipse fitting; the repo ships three module scripts, requirements.txt and yolov8s.pt weights.
items.brief: 一套面向教学与大创场景的完整非侵入式 BCI 实现：SSVEP 视觉刺激加蓝牙脑电采集，用 FBCCA 做频率识别，再把意图映射为机械臂扫描、抓取、左右移动与复位动作，目标定位交给 YOLOv8。README 给出频率-意图-动作对照表和模块划分（刺激、控制、检测），适合想复现「脑电到设备控制」闭环的入门团队；但仓库今日刚创建、无提交历史与许可说明，稳定性需自行验证。

items.brief_en: A nine-minute Chinese explainer showing why univariate electrode-by-electrode screening misses information: opposing effects across channels cancel when averaged, yet samples separate linearly in the two-channel plane. It then covers time-resolved MVPA steps and chance-level interpretation for readers moving beyond ERP amplitudes.
items.title_zh: 单变量与多变量：一次讲清区别（EEG 分析）
items.title_en: Univariate Versus Multivariate EEG Analysis, Explained Once
bullets_zh: 用两通道反例切入：同一对 A/B 条件在通道一上 A 大、通道二上 B 大，取均值后差异直接消失。
把该时刻的样本投影到双通道平面后可见清晰分界，说明信息常存在于通道组合关系而非单个电极幅度。
给出逐时刻 MVPA 建模流程与解读方式：二分类随机水平为 1/2，基线期接近随机、刺激后准确率上升但不超过 1。
bullets_en: Opens with a two-channel counterexample: condition A exceeds B on channel one while B exceeds A on channel two, so averaging erases the effect.
Projecting that time point onto the two-channel plane reveals a clean boundary, showing information can live in channel combinations rather than single electrodes.
Walks through time-resolved MVPA modelling and interpretation: chance is 1/2 for two classes, baseline sits near chance and accuracy rises after stimulus onset.
items.brief: 9 分钟中文讲解，用一个两通道反例说明为什么 EEG 里「单变量找显著电极」会漏掉信息：当 A/B 条件在两个通道上方向相反时均值互相抵消，但在双通道平面上样本线性可分。随后给出逐时刻 MVPA 的建模步骤与随机水平基线的解读方法。适合刚进入脑电解码、准备从 ERP 幅值分析转向多变量方法的读者作为低成本入门材料；配套练习可自行用公开数据集复现该曲线。

items.brief_en: A five-minute Chinese explainer on why functional localization precision caps BCI decoding performance, listing cortical targets per task and separating non-invasive localization (fMRI, MEG, TMS) from invasive confirmation, with fMRI answering where a function lives.
items.title_zh: 为什么 BCI 需要精准脑区定位？
items.title_en: Why BCI Needs Precise Cortical Targeting
bullets_zh: 从 BCI 的前提切入：只有运动、语言等功能相对固定地落在特定脑区，才可能在局部采集信号并解码。
按任务列靶区：运动重建对应初级运动皮层、前运动区与辅助运动区；言语重建关注 Broca 区、Wernicke 区与顶下小叶。
区分两条定位路径：非侵入式 fMRI、MEG、TMS 无创可重复、适合术前筛选；侵入式为直接电刺激、ECoG 与微电极记录，并指出毫米级误差就会改变解码对象。
bullets_en: Starts from a precondition of BCI: decoding local signals only makes sense when functions such as movement and speech map to fairly fixed cortex.
Maps targets by task: motor reconstruction uses primary motor, premotor and supplementary areas, while speech reconstruction concerns Broca, Wernicke and inferior parietal regions.

Contrasts localization routes: non-invasive fMRI, MEG and TMS are repeatable for pre-surgical screening, versus direct electrical stimulation, ECoG and microelectrodes, noting millimetre errors change what is decoded.
items.brief: 5 分 43 秒中文讲解，主题是功能定位精度如何决定 BCI 解码性能上限：毫米级误差就会改变被解码的脑区。视频按任务列出对应靶区（运动、抓握、感知觉、言语），并区分非侵入式定位手段（fMRI、MEG、TMS）与侵入式验证手段（直接电刺激、ECoG、微电极），指出 fMRI 的核心价值是回答「功能在哪里」。适合在做电极靶点选择、术前评估流程或非侵入式方案对比时作为索引材料。
